title: Manila Implements Road Closures and Rerouting for Undas 2026
text: Manila Implements Road Closures and Rerouting for Undas 2026 The Manila Public Information Office has issued a traffic advisory for the Undas 2026 period. The plan, effective from October 30th to November 1st, includes the closure of several streets near the Manila North Cemetery and provides specific rerouting instructions for motorists to avoid congestion during the holiday. The Manila City government has announced road closures and traffic rerouting plans for the Undas 2026 observance, centered around the Manila North Cemetery. From October 30th at midnight through November 1st, several key streets will be affected. Specifically, the stretch of Dimasalang Street between Retiro and Calavite, as well as Felix Huertas Street from Blumentritt to Aurora Boulevard, will be closed to vehicular traffic. The city has provided specific instructions for drivers: those on Dimasalang Road heading towards Blumentritt should turn right on Simoun Street; vehicles on A. Bonifacio Avenue should turn left on Labo Street; cars on Maceda Street should turn right on Simoun; and drivers on Aurora Boulevard should turn right on Leonor Rivera Street.The government advises all motorists to plan their journeys in advance and utilize alternative routes to minimize disruptions.
